verdict.rationale: Eqvista's docs say it supports uncertificated (electronic) and certificated (digital or paper) shares. Its certificates support category covers executor signing roles, shareholder signing and certificate reissue, and the Premium plan lists "E-signing certificates" backed by built-in e-signing. Share issuance itself happens inside the cap table workflow. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the e-signatures are legally binding (e.g., ESIGN compliance), documentation that each certificate stays permanently linked to its specific cap table entry (only implied by in-platform issuance and reissue), independent or hands-on corroboration, and availability on the free tier (e-signing is Premium-only).
